blurb: This check verifies that AIX does not process ICMP timestamp requests: the IPsec filter device is Available (lsdev -Cc ipsec shows ipsec_v4 or ipsec_v6) and the filter table (lsfilt) denies ICMP type 13 (timestamp request) inbound and ICMP type 14 (timestamp reply) outbound. Answering ICMP timestamp requests widens the network attack surface.
